body:
Quick pass (coordinator, read only, no build) on head `4ca5c2f9e`: the PR is a sub-PR of `side/path-kernel` and merges cleanly with it (`25f3838db`). The author's gate is green on the tree of this head: the quick gate became a full batch run, because `camcraft-geometry` changes (1223 steps, 0 failed, clippy and the three example catalog suites included), and the light lane (7 steps). The writer record on #4177 is released. The body starts with `Side branch: side/path-kernel` and has `Refs #4177`. The PR is flagged ready. It waits for the independent review.

Notes for the reviewer:
- The trial merge and the gate base are `origin/side/path-kernel`.
- The safety floor applies: the link stage decides where the tool stays down. No old planner calls the new code; with the default switch the output is identical.
- The PR changes the trait `LinkProof::link` (it takes a `Level`), and adds three functions to `camcraft-geometry` (`segments_cross`, `segment_gap`, `point_segment_distance`). A point that is not a number counts as "not proved apart".
- Check the constant `AIR = 0.1`: a tool centre within 0.1 tool radius of the stock edge counts as air. The author took the value from the old ring links and did not read how the old code uses it.
- The measured counts are in the body: 0 lifts and 0 crossing feeds on the disc and the dog bone, and 5 to 7 lifts with named reasons on the pocket with an island. Check that each of those lifts has no provable in-plane link.
- A worker adds the medial line, trace and helix planners at the same time (#4176, sub-PR 2). The two PRs add lines to the same module lists.

needs-rework: one doc-accuracy item on the `AIR` constant (proof.rs:28-30 and the decision record) — the comment says "half of the tool is in the air" where the code treats a centre within 0.1 tool radius of the stock edge as open ground. The class: a doc that misstates a safety-relevant constant. One rule closes it: every doc line about a numeric safety constant must name the exact use and the exact meaning of the number. Everything else is clean (122 law tests, motion kernel_laws 29, geometry 86+16, clippy clean, light lane 7/7).

Review fix for head `4ca5c2f9e` (the review of `4ca5c2f9e`). The new head is `d50f14a5435b939e17bd2f15e3127b0c0cc64b59`. It waits for a fresh review. The earlier review does not count for this head.

The class of the requested item: a doc and a rule that state a safety constant wrongly. The one rule now: the link proof counts only proved ground as open. Open ground is the air of the region, or a sample within the swath (0.9 tool radius) of a cut already made. The strip just inside the stock edge has no rule of its own.

Commit `de486804b` closes these findings:
- Requested item 1 and the first note (the meaning of `AIR`). The first head counted a centre within 0.1 tool radius of the stock edge, on either side, as open. Inside the stock, such a centre cuts up to 1.1 tool radii into stock that no cut has cleared. The old ring links mean "outside the stock by 0.1 r". The kernel's centre area ends at the stock edge and its air starts one tool radius outside. Thus no link sample can stand in that band, and the margin has no use. The constant `AIR` is removed. The doc of `proof.rs` and the decision file say what the code does.
- New pin: `a_link_along_the_stock_edge_over_uncut_stock_is_refused`. The outermost cuts are 1.25 tool radii from the edge. The link in the strip along the edge is refused with `UNCUT_STOCK`. The same link stays when a made cut clears the strip.
- Note 4 (`unwrap_or(Hop::Lift(CUTS_PART))`). The proof now returns `LiftReason` values that are built from the named constants. Each case has its own arm and no fallback: a path with no finite point lifts with `BAD_PATH`, a region that is not planar lifts with `NOT_PLANAR_LINK` (it was `CUTS_PART`), and the policy match is exhaustive.
- The pins for notes 2 and 3 are in this commit too (see below).

Commit `d50f14a54` closes these notes:
- Note 2 (`Span::Whole`). A curve that is full-width as a whole comes after the other ready curves (this was already so). It has no stretch end, so it starts as a plain curve: at its vertex nearest the tool that the link proves. The `starts` match now names each case. Pin: `a_whole_full_width_curve_is_cut_after_the_other_ready_curves`.
- Note 3 (the first row). A row on the first step is never reversed, on purpose. It runs as the canonical guide set gives it, so the first cut is deterministic. A comment says so. Pin: `a_row_on_the_first_step_keeps_its_direction_and_the_next_rows_zigzag`.
- Note 5 (the `planned` list on each step). The walk now builds the planned cuts once and removes each cut that it takes. The order stays O(n^2) in total, because each proof builds the lines of the level. A cache for the lines is not in this step.

Measured lift and crossing counts after the change (no tuning of a constant):

| Fixture (motion `kernel_laws`) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| disc, Inside | 0 lifts / 0 crossings | 0 / 0 |
| disc, Outside | 0 / 0 | 13 lifts, each named / 0 |
| dog bone, Inside | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 |
| dog bone, Outside | 0 / 0 | 15 lifts, each named / 0 |

Law suite, Auto / Inside / Outside: the disc pocket 0 / 0 / 0; the disc band 13 / 0 / 13 (5 `CROSSES_CUT`, 4 `UNCUT_STOCK`, 4 `CUTS_PART`); the dog-bone band 15 / 0 / 15 (13 `CROSSES_CUT`, 2 `UNCUT_STOCK`); the pocket with an island 7 / 7 / 5 (no change). The new lifts are on Outside: the link from one piece at the stock edge to the next runs over uncut stock, and the kernel cannot leave the stock into the air. Follow-up: #4241.

Gates on the final head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/side/path-kernel`: 1223 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. This includes clippy `-D warnings`, `laws`, `kernel_laws` and the `example_catalog*` suites.
- `cargo check --tests` for pathkernel and motion, the `laws` suite (125 passed), the `kernel_laws` suite (29 passed), clippy on pathkernel and motion: all clean.
- The light lane did not run again: the kernel has no caller yet, and the light twins do not reach it.

The PR body and `docs/decisions/4177-kernel-order-link.md` have the new rule and the new counts.

merge-ready: the needs-rework item (the AIR doc line) is closed by the fix commits on this head. Fresh review on d50f14a54 is clean: laws 125, kernel_laws 29, pathkernel lib 5, geometry 86+16, clippy -D warnings clean, and the three review-fix pins verified locally. The full batch gate is author-gated (1223 steps, 0 failed, from the author's record on this head).

Effort: max (issue #4177)

Left for the maintainer: feat kernel PR (order/link stage for the path kernel, safety-floor link-proof code) - feat PRs merge at the cut, and PRs touching kernel geometry merge by the maintainer, not by the sweep.

Merge into `side/path-kernel` (coordinator of NeoTech): the head merges cleanly with the side branch at `25f3838db`. The merge relies on the clean review of 2026-11-27T00:03:20Z on head `d50f14a54` by the review session camcraft-61 (a separate session from the author's workers, same GitHub account). The writer record is released, and no reviewer record is active. Maintainer order (question dialog, 2026-11-26): this session merges reviewed sub-PRs of `side/path-kernel`. Nothing merges to `main` here.
